import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes (mean difference in outcome groups)
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        group0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        group1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        effect = np.mean(group1) - np.mean(group0)
        effect_sizes.append(abs(effect))
    
    # Rank features by effect size
    ranked_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1]
    
    # Select top candidates
    candidates = [feats.ids[i] for i in ranked_indices[:10]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    to_remove = set()
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in candidates]]).round(2)
    for i in range(len(candidates)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(candidates)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(candidates[j])
    
    drivers = [fid for fid in candidates if fid not in to_remove][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    
    # Build regression components
    columns = list(set(candidates) - to_remove)
    
    # Add interaction terms for strong correlations
    products = []
    for i in range(len(columns)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(columns)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                products.append((columns[i], columns[j]))
    
    # Simple weighted score using top features
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(columns):
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        loadings[fid] = effect_sizes[idx]
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
